Checking language support on an unregistered OCR backend returns an error, since there is no backend to delegate the check to

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ocrBackendSupportsLanguage } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
function main() {
try {
    ocrBackendSupportsLanguage("nonexistent-backend-xyz", "eng");
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      console.error(`${error.name}: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
}

void main();
```
